correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=3 and real k>0, the Laplacian block form and Schur-complement resolvent give exact formulas for all four symmetry-orbit inverse traces. Explicit subtraction shows CC strictly beats CO and LL, while CC-CX has sign of 2k²+m(6-m)k-m²(m-2), with one positive root m(m-6+sqrt(m²-4m+20))/4. Every pair is in exactly one of these four orbits. Full symbolic identities reproduced from packaged verify.py plus 980 exact-rational full-matrix instances for m=3..7 verify independent computations; finite tests do not replace the all-parameter algebraic proof. Boundary cases m=3, k->0+ and finite k and equality are explicitly accounted for.

value.rationale: The theorem determines all optimal locations and a sharp gain-dependent switch on an unbounded, natural clique-with-private-leaves network. The core/core solution wins for small gain while a core/unpaired-leaf pair wins for large gain; the precise crossover is size-dependent and asymptotically m²/2. The two losing pair types are rigorously excluded for all gains. Such sharp design decisions are not supplied by a generic inverse-trace formula without substantive orbit comparisons, and the precise parameter regime is relevant for placing two finite-strength controllers.
